label: WP-C, pre-registered in ANALYSIS_PLAN Amendment 11 (commit 598dd99). Anything else derived from these files is exploratory, post hoc.
c1_passive_thresholds.json: A11.1 thresholds fitted on the 12 calibration geometries (committed a702d35 before any held-out passive score)
c1_passive_vs_active.csv: A11.1 passive vs frozen active imperfect_robust SUPPORTED, held-out sigma 0.5 and 6 standoff levels; geometry bootstrap; cp95_upper_if_zero = one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson bound, 0 of n geometries
c1_passive_rows.parquet: per-record passive and active rows (held-out and standoff)
c2_controller.csv: A11.2 controller outcome per run and world; cost unit = one 122.88 MHz wall probe
c2_fresh_trials/: the fresh 245.76 MHz trials (new seed bases 33201/34201/35201); 47 held-out + 27 standoff_15m
